admission.justification: The public plan cannot conceal a format refusal behind a code-tip error or block opening a FIFO marker. Format-first and differing-version tests guard this distinct converted-pair admission beyond existing legacy refusal.

applicability: Format admission for converted-memory carryover plan and apply.
conditions: Source and target memory roots must each hold a regular valid converted layout marker with the same conversion-format version.
The public plan checks formats before code-tip, cleanliness and candidate reads; apply checks them before its authority/candidate reads, after checking the required nonblank intent_note.
A missing/non-directory root is a named root error, not fabricated legacy memory.
exclusions: This extends converted-pair/version admission, not the already stored universal legacy refusal INV-JT28KJ.
Marker presence alone is not validator acceptance.
Configuration/request construction and intent-note checking are not subsequent candidate reads.

evidence: Frozen generation3 source inspection; no new execution or acceptance.

statement: Carryover refuses missing or unequal conversion-format markers before subsequent candidate reads.
